title: rottlera subpeltata
intro: Rottlera subpeltata, commonly known as Khamin, is a plant species belonging to the family Celastraceae, native to tropical regions of Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, helping to alleviate various conditions like fever, diarrhea, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Rottlera subpeltata include its potential to exhibit analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a sought-after remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Rottlera subpeltata include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential to combat various diseases.
